name: Contracts read by hand
summary: Contracts read by hand: contract emails are logged from the inbox, the owner gets a drafted review note with a register row, and unsigned signers on envelopes out for signature get reminders queued for approval. Crons read and draft; a person approves every email.

covered_by.contract-received: intake (contract emails logged from the folder)
covered_by.other: review (note to the owner); the clause reading itself is skill work

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: Contract emails from the folder, each logged once as new.

crons.name: review
crons.summary: A register row and a review note for each new contract; the note's send waits for approval.

crons.name: follow-up
crons.summary: Reminders to unsigned signers on envelopes out for signature, queued for approval on the set schedule (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads, an email draft in the client's mailbox, a register row. Sending an email is a live operation and waits for a person.

microsoft-365.covers: contract emails in, review note to the owner, register row, reminder drafts

docusign.covers: envelopes out for signature and each signer's status (read only)

gaps: Clause reading, redlines, specialist advice, negotiation and approval require human judgment. Confirm the workflow steps with the business before use.
No platform had help-centre docs, so the two adapters were chosen by job fit from the kit, not by support.
No cron reads contract text. The intake logs attachment names and sizes only; reading the document is the owner's or the agent's step.
PandaDoc and Clio have mapped operations in the kit but no adapter here: no evidence this owner uses them, and Clio is a legal matter system. Leap is not in the kit.
Storing the signed copy, tracking renewal and notice dates, and sending for signature are not built.
Both adapters are docs-only. DocuSign is marked spec in the kit, and the Microsoft 365 sign-in is a supplied Graph access token. Prove both against a sandbox before any client.
